# SoCO Research Forum

The Society of Cutaneous Oncology Research Forum is a recurring venue for investigators to present work in progress, refine study concepts, and develop collaborative projects in skin cancer.

# Overview

In an effort to fulfill our missions of supporting SoCO members in producing high-quality, reproducible science and educating future generations of clinical oncologists and scientific investigators dedicated to skin cancer, the Society of Cutaneous Oncology supports an open forum for research discussions and presentations that convenes several times per year.

The Research Forum is intended to be informal, constructive, and collaborative. Presentations may include early research concepts, preliminary analyses, trial designs, methodological questions, data-sharing opportunities, or mature projects seeking multidisciplinary feedback.
